description: Let \(L_0=L_1\cap L_2\) inside an arbitrary ambient signature. If \(T_0\) is a complete satisfiable \(L_0\)-theory and each satisfiable \(L_i\)-theory \(T_i\) contains its translated axioms, then the translated union \(T_1\cup T_2\) has a nonempty model. The extensions need not be complete.
